title: The documentation
html:
The documentation

The public docs are written as a journey — start there:

Doc What
docs/getting-started/ Start here. Why Golmet exists, and the journey: the Organization, the project, working with AI, the cycle of one feature, what remains at the end
docs/concepts/overview.md What GOLMET delivers — the full map in one page: everything, layer by layer (the tutorials show the journey; this is the map)
docs/concepts/artefatos.md The artifact architecture: what each document is for, what feeds it, what it feeds
docs/recommended.md The recommended mode (Organization + FULL + Opencode) — and what you lose without it
docs/concepts/ The concepts in depth: organization and versioning, content layers, profile, knowledge, self-governing
docs/FORMAT.md The normative spec (v1) — the contract every check enforces
docs/reference/compatibility.md The real MCP x engine compatibility matrix - verified cell by cell, locked by tests (honest "unverified" marks)
docs/reference/ Reference: the 18 commands, the 14 MCP tools
docs/reference/lint.md The lint layers in depth: what each check (L1-L14) validates, why it exists, its finding example and the test that locks it
CHANGELOG.md Wave by wave, with the real-world motivation
LICENSE MIT

The public site renders this documentation tree after the release — the repo is the source, the site is a render.
